title: 南北长街 (买卖街) Nanbei Changjie (Maimai Jie)
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: No box in the 3D view: the plan shows no building here, or a plot, water, a hill or a name only.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 同乐园、舍卫城
evidence.excerpt_zh: 麴院風荷之北為同樂園前後樓各五楹南向其前為清音閣北向東為永日堂中有南北長街街西為抱樸草堂街北度雙橋為舎衛城前樹坊楔三城南面為多寳閣内為山門正殿為壽國壽民後為仁慈殿又後為普福宫城北為最勝閣（圓明園册）臣等謹按永日堂壽國壽民仁慈殿普福宫諸額皆世宗御書舍衛城北坊額曰花界曰香城東曰□湧曰金池西曰曇霏曰珠林多寳閣祀闗帝額曰至聖大勇夀國夀民殿額曰心月妙相仁慈殿額曰具足圓成普福宫額曰瑞應優曇最勝閣坊額曰乾闥持輪曰祗林垂鬘皆御書
evidence.summary: North of 麴院風荷: 同樂園, front and rear five-bay towers facing south, the theatre 清音閣 facing north, 永日堂, a shopping street, 抱樸草堂. North over twin bridges: the walled temple 舎衛城 with three archways, 多寳閣, a gate, 壽國壽民, 仁慈殿, 普福宫 and 最勝閣. The note gives each plaque and arch.

evidence.title: 竹葉亭雜記
evidence.excerpt_zh: 圆明园福海之东有同乐园，每岁赐诸臣观剧于此。高庙时，每新岁园中设有买卖街，凡古玩估衣以及茶馆饭肆，一切动用诸物悉备，外间所有者无不有之，虽至携小筐卖瓜子者亦备焉。开店者俱以内监为之。其古玩等器，由崇文门监督先期于外城各肆中采择交入，言明价值，具于册。卖去者给值，存者归物。各大臣至园，许竞相购买之。各执事官退出后，日将晡，内宫亦至其肆市物焉。其执事等官，俱得集于酒馆饭肆哺啜，与在外等。馆肆中走堂者，俱挑取外城各肆中之声音响亮、口齿伶俐者充之。每俟驾过店门，则走堂者呼茶，店小二报账，掌柜者核算，众音杂逻，纷纷并起，以为新年游观之乐。至燕九日始辍。盖以九重欲周知民间风景之意也。造办处笔帖式徐君善庆每岁入直，言之最详。晚间仍备嘎嘎灯焉。嘉庆四年此例停止。
evidence.summary: The New Year market of the Qianlong years in the garden, run by eunuchs, with goods chosen from the city's shops and sold at agreed prices; it places 同樂園 east of 福海, which differs from S05.

evidence.title: Attiret: the fair
evidence.excerpt_other: There is one Quarter for those who sell Silks, and another for those who sell Cloth; one Street for Porcelain, and another for Varnish-works.
evidence.summary: Held several times a year, played by eunuchs, with real goods entrusted by Peking merchants. Princes rarely admitted, and then only after the women had left.

evidence.title: Scene 38, 坐石临流 Zuoshi Linliu, and 舍卫城 Shewei Cheng
evidence.excerpt_other: Not far west of the Happy Sea a granite road between two rows of buildings, which included a theater and which looked like a business street in a city, crossed a bridge over a canal, and led up to a gate in a fortified wall like the entrance of a city.
evidence.summary: Granite road with shops and a theatre, a bridge, then the gate of 舍卫城 (Sravasti) in a walled enclosure with a pailou before it, red-walled temples inside, a similar gate on the north. The small pavilion over a rocky stream gave the scene its name. N.45: yellow glazed tile pieces found by Malone, inscribed She Wei Ch'eng and "made in the 15th year"; probably the 佛城 being built in 1740. The fair of the court was held on this street.

evidence.title: Attiret: the little town
evidence.excerpt_other: It has Four Gates, answering the Four principal Points of the Compass; with Towers, Walls, Parapets, and Battlements. It has it's Streets, Squares, Temples, Exchanges, Markets, Shop, Tribunals, Palaces, and a Port for Vessels.
evidence.summary: A small walled town reached by a nearly straight road from the emperor's palace, each side near a mile by his figure; S02 p.136 n. thinks the figure includes the shop street. Malone identifies it with 舍卫城 and the street south of it.

evidence.title: Attiret (French original): the little town with four gates
evidence.excerpt_other: De ce logement de l'Empereur le chemin conduit presque tout droit à une petite ville, bâtie au milieu de tout l'enclos. Son étendue est d'un quart de lieue en tout sens. Elle a ses quatre portes aux quatre points cardinaux; ses tours, ses murailles, ses parapets, ses crénaux. Elle a ses rues, ses places, ses temples, ses halles, ses marchés, ses boutiques, ses tribunaux, ses palais, son port.
evidence.summary: French text behind E2174 and E2160: a walled mock town in the middle of the enclosure, a quarter league each way, with four gates, towers, crenellated walls, streets, temples, markets, shops and a port, where the eunuchs staged a fair for the court. The size is far larger than 舍卫城 on S01; see the question row.

evidence.title: 圆明园买卖街钩沉
evidence.summary: The two shop streets. 同乐园's runs over 130 m north-south, split by a stream and 双桥, to the south of 舍卫城, in place by 1744. 含经堂's, dug in 2001-02, has a base 135.65 x about 6.3 m and 28 stoves, so perhaps eating houses. It has 40 shop bays in 9 units, against 10 buildings on the Yangshi Lei plan.

evidence.title: 圆明园同乐园的功能及其文化内涵
evidence.summary: 同乐园 Tongle Yuan, part of 坐石临流, was the court's main entertainment quarter, begun early Yongzheng: stage 清音阁, main hall, temple 永日堂 and the shop street. Emperor below and empresses above in the viewing hall; princes and envoys in east and west wings of 14 bays each. Nine upper buildings of 64 bays. Street T-shaped, 120 x 100 m.

evidence.title: 清代三山五园地区的买卖街
evidence.summary: Places the garden shop streets among those of the other imperial gardens: mock markets for the court's amusement, also supplying attendants and officials.

evidence.title: 舍卫城 多宝阁, 城隍庙, 龙王庙; 买卖街 龙王庙 (S47 sections 2.14-2.15)
evidence.summary: 多宝阁, the gate tower at the south of the city, three bays and hip-and-gable, housed Guandi. A 城隍庙 with flagpoles stood in the city by 1777, place unknown. Yangshi Lei plans show two more one-bay dragon-king shrines of the 坐石临流 area: west of 买卖街, and outside the east side of 舍卫城 by the water.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

facts.label: Note
facts.value: New Year fair street (S02 p.94; S06). function: New Year mock market run by eunuchs with goods from the Peking shops, held under Qianlong until the 燕九 day of the first month; stopped in 嘉庆四年 (1799), so in 1860 the street stood without its fair (S211, 卷一, line 37 (E2151)).
